messages:
cameron-fin: FYI: AtlasGrid (acct AG-004) has overdue INV-2026-518 for $3,250. Dunning email sent 3/2 and 3/9, no reply. Thinking a short split-pay to avoid disrupting their staging cluster. @nathan-am @anjali-collections

sasha-cs: Client messaged support saying they see a duplicate invoice in their system and are disputing one line item (usage spike). Theyre asking us to pause escalation while they investigate.

nathan-am: Spoke with their finance lead. They accept the total but asked to split into 2 payments: $1,625 today and $1,625 in 30 days. They also requested we waive the $25 processing fee if they pay on time.

anjali-collections: Collections policy: we can accept a two-part plan if initial payment clears and a signed amendment is returned. Require POP for the wire and card on file fallback. Suggest suspension trigger at 7 days past missed due date. Fee waivers need VP sign-off.

miriam-legal: I can produce a short amendment (one-pager) with auto-charge fallback and a dispute clause for the contested line item. Who will gather signatures?

cameron-fin: I will draft the schedule. Invoice INV-2026-518 issued 2026-04-02, due 2026-05-01, amount $3,250. Proposed amendment: $1,625 immediate (wire or ACH), remainder 2026-06-01. If initial payment is by wire, ask them to include invoice number in memo. Wire instructions snippet for client: ```Bank: First Redwood Bank
Routing: 011000015
Acct: 123456789
Ref: INV-2026-518```

payment-bot: Notice: automated dunning email scheduled for 2026-05-04 if no payment recorded.

nathan-am: Client says they can ACH $1,625 today and will sign amendment. Will upload POP here once submitted. They also asked for a short window to resolve the disputed usage line; ok with charges being held pending resolution if we get initial payment.

vp-finance: Approve conditional $25 processing fee waiver if initial payment clears and amendment is fully executed within 72 hours. Finance to confirm cleared funds before removing fee. No other concessions.

anjali-collections: I'll prepare the amendment language and set the suspension rule to 7 days after missed due date. Collections will hold further external escalation while initial payment is in transit. Please cc collections@redwood-inference.com on executed doc.

miriam-legal: Draft uploaded: https://console.redwood.com/invoices/INV-2026-518/amendment. Tagging parties for signature.

cameron-fin: Action items: Nathan to upload POP and collect signature; Collections to mark invoice as "payment plan pending"; Finance will watch for cleared funds and confirm waiver. I'll update ledger once funds clear.

nathan-am: Will upload remittance proof and signed amendment once both are done. Thanks. :thumbsup:
